findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_note" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_note · Private data: create_note · Public sink: create_note · Destructive: read_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_note · Private data: create_note · Public sink: create_note · Destructive: read_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "read_note" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
